rows.text: September LCL volume of 689,000 cbm, down 4% YoY and 4% MoM on supply constraints and vessel roll-overs; FCL volume 48,758 TEUs, down 10% YoY on the Middle East conflict; 40-foot container utilisation improved YoY.
**CRISIL rates it A-/Stable long term and A2+ short term**; the intimation does not state the previous levels.
